displayPattern: Status LED: 2 short flash(es) then 4 long flash(es) (code 24)
meaning: Secondary voltage (24 V) fuse is open.
causes: Short circuit in secondary (24 V) wiring, including thermostat leads
diySteps: Technician: disconnect thermostat leads to isolate the short circuit
Technician: repair the short and replace the fuse
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: if the fuse blows again; a short must be located.
